import re, subprocess, statistics, time
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path("/Users/sinchunyeung/.treehouse/simplification-of-trajectory-streams-bec452/2/simplification-of-trajectory-streams")
BASE = Path("/tmp/simplify-iter6-baseline")
NEW = REPO / "build-release" / "simplify"
CORE_RE = re.compile(r"SIMPLIFY_CORE_MS:\s*([\d.]+)")
PTS_RE = re.compile(r"SIMPLIFIED_POINTS:\s*(\d+)")

def run(bin_path, idv, eps, delta, timed=False, dist=False, timeout=180):
    cmd = [str(bin_path), "--in", str(idv), "-e", str(eps), "-d", str(delta)]
    if timed:
        cmd.append("--time")
    if dist:
        cmd.append("--dist")
    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=REPO, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{bin_path} id={idv} e={eps} d={delta} rc={proc.returncode}\n{proc.stderr[-800:]}")
    core = CORE_RE.search(proc.stderr)
    pts = PTS_RE.search(proc.stderr)
    return {
        "core": float(core.group(1)) if core else None,
        "pts": int(pts.group(1)) if pts else None,
        "stdout": proc.stdout,
        "stderr": proc.stderr,
    }

# Fast point-count matrix with --time (one run each)
cases = []
for idv in (1, 5, 10):
    cases += [
        (idv, 299.0, 1.0),
        (idv, 0.5, 200.0),
        (idv, 2.0, 100.0),
        (idv, 0.25, 400.0),
        (idv, 1.0, 50.0),
        (idv, 5.0, 200.0),
    ]

print("=== Point counts (--time, one shot) ===")
print(f"{'id':>3} {'eps':>7} {'delta':>7} {'base_pts':>8} {'new_pts':>8} {'d_pts':>6} {'base_ms':>9} {'new_ms':>9} {'ratio':>7}")
regress_pts = []
for idv, eps, delta in cases:
    b = run(BASE, idv, eps, delta, timed=True)
    n = run(NEW, idv, eps, delta, timed=True)
    dpts = n["pts"] - b["pts"]
    ratio = n["core"] / b["core"] if b["core"] else float("nan")
    flag = " FAIL" if dpts > 0 else ""
    print(f"{idv:3d} {eps:7.2f} {delta:7.1f} {b['pts']:8d} {n['pts']:8d} {dpts:6d} {b['core']:9.3f} {n['core']:9.3f} {ratio:7.3f}{flag}")
    if dpts > 0:
        regress_pts.append((idv, eps, delta, b["pts"], n["pts"]))

print(f"\npoint regressions: {len(regress_pts)}")

python3 << 'PY'
import re, subprocess, statistics, hashlib
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path("/Users/sinchunyeung/.treehouse/simplification-of-trajectory-streams-bec452/2/simplification-of-trajectory-streams")
BASE = Path("/tmp/simplify-iter6-baseline")
NEW = REPO / "build-release" / "simplify"
CORE_RE = re.compile(r"SIMPLIFY_CORE_MS:\s*([\d.]+)")
RAW_DIST_RE = re.compile(r"^[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?$", re.M)
LABEL_DIST_RE = re.compile(r"Frechet distance:\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)", re.I)

def run(bin_path, idv, eps, delta, dist=False, timeout=180):
    cmd = [str(bin_path), "--in", str(idv), "-e", str(eps), "-d", str(delta)]
    if dist:
        cmd.append("--dist")
    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=REPO, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{bin_path.name if hasattr(bin_path,'name') else bin_path} id={idv} e={eps} d={delta} rc={proc.returncode}\n{proc.stderr[-800:]}\n{proc.stdout[-400:]}")
    core = CORE_RE.search(proc.stderr)
    text = proc.stdout + "\n" + proc.stderr
    d = None
    if dist:
        ms = RAW_DIST_RE.findall(text)
        if ms:
            d = float(ms[-1])
        else:
            m = LABEL_DIST_RE.search(text)
            if m:
                d = float(m.group(1))
    simp = REPO / "data" / str(idv) / "simplify.txt"
    digest = hashlib.sha256(simp.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if dist and simp.exists() else None
    npts = None
    if dist and simp.exists():
        npts = int(simp.read_text().splitlines()[0])
    return {
        "core": float(core.group(1)) if core else None,
        "dist": d,
        "digest": digest,
        "npts": npts,
    }

# Interleaved no-timer medians
print("=== Interleaved no-timer medians (5 pairs) ===")
bench_cases = [
    (1, 299.0, 1.0),
    (10, 299.0, 1.0),
    (1, 0.5, 200.0),
    (10, 0.5, 200.0),
    (10, 0.25, 400.0),
    (5, 0.25, 400.0),
    (10, 1.0, 50.0),
    (10, 2.0, 100.0),
]
print(f"{'id':>3} {'eps':>7} {'delta':>7} {'base_med':>9} {'new_med':>9} {'ratio':>7}")
for idv, eps, delta in bench_cases:
    bt, nt = [], []
    for _ in range(5):
        bt.append(run(BASE, idv, eps, delta)["core"])
        nt.append(run(NEW, idv, eps, delta)["core"])
    bm, nm = statistics.median(bt), statistics.median(nt)
    print(f"{idv:3d} {eps:7.2f} {delta:7.1f} {bm:9.3f} {nm:9.3f} {nm/bm:7.3f}   base={['%.2f'%x for x in bt]} new={['%.2f'%x for x in nt]}")

print("\n=== Frechet + output digest ===")
dist_cases = [
    (1, 299.0, 1.0),
    (5, 299.0, 1.0),
    (10, 299.0, 1.0),
    (1, 0.5, 200.0),
    (5, 0.5, 200.0),
    (10, 0.5, 200.0),
    (1, 0.25, 400.0),
    (10, 0.25, 400.0),
    (10, 1.0, 50.0),
]
print(f"{'id':>3} {'eps':>7} {'delta':>7} {'base_d':>12} {'new_d':>12} {'d_dist':>10} {'pts':>6} {'same_file':>9}")
for idv, eps, delta in dist_cases:
    b = run(BASE, idv, eps, delta, dist=True, timeout=300)
    n = run(NEW, idv, eps, delta, dist=True, timeout=300)
    same = "YES" if b["digest"] == n["digest"] else "no"
    dd = (n["dist"] - b["dist"]) if (n["dist"] is not None and b["dist"] is not None) else float("nan")
    print(f"{idv:3d} {eps:7.2f} {delta:7.1f} {b['dist']:12.6f} {n['dist']:12.6f} {dd:10.6f} {n['npts']:6d} {same:>9}  base_pts={b['npts']}")
PY
